all.source_quote: less than 55 years at the time of child birth

any.source_quote: Women whose net family income is less than ₹ 8 Lakh per annum
Women holder of BPL ration Card
Women who are partially (40%) or fully disabled (Divyang Jan)

unmodelled.text: Minimum age is 18 years and 7 months at childbirth (not expressible in whole years)
unmodelled.source_quote: The age of beneficiary under PMMVY should be 18 years

unmodelled.text: Second-child benefit only if the second child is a girl
unmodelled.source_quote: PMMVY benefit given for second child also, if the second child is girl

unmodelled.text: Is a woman farmer receiving PM-KISAN
unmodelled.source_quote: Women farmers who are beneficiaries under Kisan Samman Nidhi
Women Beneficiaries under Pradhan Mantri Jan Aarogya Yojana (PMJAY) under Ayushman Bharat

unmodelled.text: Is a pregnant or lactating Anganwadi worker, helper or ASHA
Holds a ration card under the National Food Security Act (NFSA), 2013
unmodelled.source_quote: Women Beneficiaries holding Ration card under National Food Security Act (NFSA), 2013

unmodelled.text: Must register within 270 days of childbirth
unmodelled.source_quote: A beneficiary is eligible to register in PMMVY till 270 days from childbirth

unmodelled.text: Must register the pregnancy and complete at least two ante-natal check-ups
unmodelled.source_quote: Registration of Pregnancy and at least two Ante-Natal Check-up (ANC) preferably within six months from LMP

unmodelled.text: First-child benefit is for the first living child
unmodelled.source_quote: Benefits would be disbursed in 2 instalments for 1st living child

unmodelled.text: Second-child benefit only for a girl born on or after 1 April 2022
unmodelled.source_quote: For beneficiaries of second girl child born on or after 1.04.2022 can apply for benefits

en.title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
en.benefit: Rs 5,000 for the first child in two instalments; Rs 6,000 for a second child if she is a girl.
en.how_to_apply: An Anganwadi or ASHA worker can fill the form online, or apply on the PMMVY portal.
